crypto-merchants.title: Six-shop refundable checkout trial
crypto-merchants.outcome: Ship an open-source checkout, with refunds, and run it for three months at six named Owen Sound shops. Publish the code and the shop list.
crypto-merchants.blocker: No one shop can justify building a checkout whose useful result is a public trial record

crypto-merchants.title: Independent checkout security review
crypto-merchants.outcome: Pay a reviewer who does not write the checkout to publish findings and unfixed items before the Owen Sound trial ends.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The shops and the programmer are poor judges of their own security claims

crypto-merchants.title: Fee and failure table
crypto-merchants.outcome: Publish the fee on a twenty-dollar Owen Sound trial sale, and a table of failed payments, before anyone calls the trial a success.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The numbers are useful to every later shop and owned by none of them

crypto-merchants.title: Owen Sound merchant directory
crypto-merchants.outcome: Maintain, for one year, a directory that shows which trial shops still take the checkout and which shops stopped, with the date of each change.
crypto-merchants.blocker: A directory nobody maintains becomes an advertisement

crypto-merchants.title: Quarterly checkout clinic and host kit
crypto-merchants.outcome: Run four Saturday clinics in Owen Sound and leave a host kit so a second person can run the next one.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The clinic stops when the first host is busy unless the hosting steps are written down

civic-assimilation.title: Twelve conversation sessions
civic-assimilation.outcome: Hold twelve English conversation sessions in Owen Sound with childcare in the room, and publish attendance without naming children.
civic-assimilation.blocker: Childcare and a room have to be paid before the first session, and no single family captures the benefit

civic-assimilation.title: Grey County civics pack
civic-assimilation.outcome: Write and release a plain-English pack for the library, the bus, a school meeting, and a township office in Grey County.
civic-assimilation.blocker: Each office explains itself differently, and no office is paid to write the combined pack

civic-assimilation.title: Harrison Park path season
civic-assimilation.outcome: Run one summer of path repair in Harrison Park, Owen Sound, with newcomers and long-time residents, and publish hours and costs.
civic-assimilation.blocker: The work needs a full season of tools and insurance before anyone can see the paths

civic-assimilation.title: Conversation-session handoff
civic-assimilation.outcome: Write the steps, contacts, and childcare arrangements so a second organizer can run the next Owen Sound session series.
civic-assimilation.blocker: The sessions are a public good only if they survive the first organizer

civic-assimilation.title: Independent tutor-listing check
civic-assimilation.outcome: For one season, have someone who does not run the sessions check Grey County language-tutor listings and publish which listings failed.
civic-assimilation.blocker: A directory checked by its own organizer does not answer a skeptic

christian-teaching.title: Midweek class notes
christian-teaching.outcome: Release the notes for one Grey County congregation's midweek class under terms another congregation can reuse.
christian-teaching.blocker: The second congregation can copy the notes, so neither congregation is paid by the other to write them

christian-teaching.title: Midweek class transcript
christian-teaching.outcome: Transcribe that class for people who cannot hear the recordings, and publish the transcript with the confession named.
christian-teaching.blocker: Transcription is useful to every later listener and costly to the first congregation

christian-teaching.title: One-season substitute rota
christian-teaching.outcome: Publish a Sunday rota and sermon notes so a substitute can preach at one named Grey County church for one season.
christian-teaching.blocker: Each small church has too few substitutes to keep the rota alone

christian-teaching.title: Second-church host kit
christian-teaching.outcome: Write a one-season kit so a second Grey County church can run the same rota without the first host.
christian-teaching.blocker: The rota dies with the first host unless the steps are written down

christian-teaching.title: Grey County class-host directory
christian-teaching.outcome: Publish one directory of Grey County people who will host a small class, with affiliation and an independent checker's note, and maintain it for one year.
christian-teaching.blocker: Churches, tutors, and home-school hosts each need the same checked list, and none of them owns it

home-learning.title: Printable grade-six science unit
home-learning.outcome: Release one grade-six science unit a Grey County family can print, with the teaching method named on the first page and no religious claims in the activities.
home-learning.blocker: Every family can copy the unit after the first author writes it

home-learning.title: Grey County field-trip pack
home-learning.outcome: Release the permission form, map, and safety notes for one Grey County field trip so another family, including a school family, can run it.
home-learning.blocker: The first family pays for the reconnaissance and every later family can copy the pack

home-learning.title: Store-item science kits
home-learning.outcome: Publish instructions for a home science kit of ordinary store items, including hazards and the adult supervision each activity needs.
home-learning.blocker: A safe kit has to be tried once before other families can reuse it

home-learning.title: Eight Owen Sound Saturdays
home-learning.outcome: Host eight Saturday meetups in Owen Sound for home-school families and publish the dates before the first meeting.
home-learning.blocker: The room and the dates have to be reserved before any family can rely on them

home-learning.title: Successor host notes
home-learning.outcome: Name a successor and write the notes so the Owen Sound meetups can run a second season without the first host.
home-learning.blocker: A meetup series that only the first host can run is not a maintained public good

abortion.title: Grand Rapids settlement sessions
abortion.outcome: Hold six moderated sessions in Grand Rapids, Michigan, on the accepted 12-16 week settlement sentence, and publish the notes. The notes do not say what Michigan law currently is.
abortion.blocker: A room, a moderator, and a published record have to be paid for before either camp can point at the same notes

abortion.title: Plain-language settlement page
abortion.outcome: Publish one page that quotes the accepted settlement sentence and says, in plain language, what a 12-16 week cutoff would allow and forbid. Do not describe that sentence as current law.
abortion.blocker: Each camp already has its own explanation, and neither is paid to write the shared one

abortion.title: Five-statement posting
abortion.outcome: Keep the five accepted abortion statements posted, unchanged, for one year, with the date of each posting.
abortion.blocker: The posting is useful to every later reader and owned by none of them

abortion.title: Settlement-session host kit
abortion.outcome: Write the steps, the room notes, and the publication checklist so a second person can run the Grand Rapids sessions without the first host.
abortion.blocker: The sessions stop when the first host is busy unless the steps are written down

abortion.title: Independent notes check
abortion.outcome: Have someone who did not host the Grand Rapids sessions check that the published notes quote the settlement sentence without adding a claim about current Michigan law.
abortion.blocker: The host is a poor judge of whether their own notes stayed inside the sentence

abortion-forum.title: Michigan authority brief
abortion-forum.outcome: Publish a two-page brief that quotes the legislature-decides sentence and the federal-statute sentence as opposing proposals, and does not say which proposal is law.
abortion-forum.blocker: Each side publishes its own brief, and nobody is paid to put the two proposals on one page

abortion-forum.title: From-the-start position page
abortion-forum.outcome: Publish one page that states the from-the-start ban and the keep-campaigning position as positions their signers hold, labeled as positions rather than as Michigan law.
abortion-forum.blocker: The page is a public record of dissent, and no single dissenter captures the benefit of maintaining it

schools.title: Grand Rapids pushing-question meetings
schools.outcome: Hold four moderated meetings in Grand Rapids where the question is whether schools are pushing kids toward LGBT identities, and publish the transcripts without a clinical claim.
schools.blocker: The transcript is useful to people who were not in the room, and the first host pays for the room

schools.title: Unchanged schools packet
schools.outcome: Print the five accepted schools statements, unchanged, in a packet for one parent meeting, and record which statement each speaker is answering.
schools.blocker: A packet everyone can copy is not paid for by the second parent who uses it

schools.title: Schools-meeting host kit
schools.outcome: Write the agenda and the publication steps so a second person can run the next pushing-question meeting without the first host.
schools.blocker: The meeting series dies with the first host unless the steps are written down

gender-conduct.title: Harassment-steps sheet
gender-conduct.outcome: Publish the reporting steps for one named Grey County school, including the line that the student need not agree with a classmate.
gender-conduct.blocker: The sheet has to be checked against the school's actual desk procedure before other parents can rely on it

gender-conduct.title: Clinician boundary page
gender-conduct.outcome: Publish one page that states the clinician-outside-the-school proposal and the schools-do-not-approve-drugs proposal, without a claim about medical outcomes.
gender-conduct.blocker: The two sentences are short, and nobody is paid to keep them from being rewritten into a treatment claim

gender-conduct.title: Courtesy and medicine one-pager
gender-conduct.outcome: Publish one page that separates using a requested classroom name from any decision about drugs or surgery, using the courtesy statement's own wording.
gender-conduct.blocker: Each argument keeps folding the name into the medical decision unless a maintained page holds them apart

gender-conduct.title: Adult-speech note
gender-conduct.outcome: Publish the wording of the adult-speech statement and a one-season note of which Grey County school-board agendas allowed that speech.
gender-conduct.blocker: The agenda record is useful to the next speaker and owned by none of them

gender-conduct.title: Conduct-page host kit
gender-conduct.outcome: Write who updates the harassment sheet and the boundary page for the next school year, so the first editor can leave.
gender-conduct.blocker: A page nobody is assigned to update becomes an old photocopy

voting.title: Owen Sound association poll
voting.outcome: Run one non-binding ranked-ballot poll at one named Owen Sound community association and publish the ballots and the ranked count. The poll does not change a municipal election.
voting.blocker: Printing, a room, and a published count have to be paid for before anyone can inspect the result

voting.title: Approval count of the same ballots
voting.outcome: Publish an approval count of those same Owen Sound ballots beside the ranked count, with both methods named.
voting.blocker: A second count is useful to people comparing methods, and the association is not paid to run it

voting.title: Rerunnable counting notes
voting.outcome: Publish the counting method in enough detail that a second person can rerun it from the published ballots and match the count.
voting.blocker: The counter who ran the poll is a poor person to be the only one who can repeat it

voting.title: Second-host poll kit
voting.outcome: Write the room, ballot, and publication steps so a second Owen Sound resident can run the next non-binding poll.
voting.blocker: The poll stops when the first host is busy unless the steps are written down

voting.title: Moderator checklist card
voting.outcome: Print the moderator checklist and use it for the Owen Sound poll and for one other published meeting, then file both checklists in the Grey County trial directory.
voting.blocker: The checklist is useful on more than one board, and neither meeting owns the maintenance

grey-assimilation.title: Owen Sound evening sessions
grey-assimilation.outcome: Run twelve evening practical-English sessions in Owen Sound with childcare, covering the library, the bus, and a township office. Township business stays in English. The sessions do not tell newcomers which customs to keep.
grey-assimilation.blocker: Childcare and a room have to be paid for before either camp can see whether the limited program is the one they would accept

grey-assimilation.title: Session-limit card
grey-assimilation.outcome: Print the commonality sentence and the two modified sentences, unchanged, so a host can show what the sessions will and will not do.
grey-assimilation.blocker: The limit is easy to drop in the room unless a card states it

ranked-approval-poll.title: Dual-count association poll
ranked-approval-poll.outcome: One Owen Sound community association runs a non-binding poll and publishes a ranked count and an approval count of the same ballots. The poll does not change a municipal election.
ranked-approval-poll.blocker: Printing both counts costs more than the association's usual show of hands

ranked-approval-poll.title: Dual-count host card
ranked-approval-poll.outcome: Print the two modified sentences so a host can say that publishing the other count is not a change of preferred system.
ranked-approval-poll.blocker: Without the card, each side hears the second count as a concession they did not make

checkout-trial-bridge.title: Six-shop trial on the bridge terms
checkout-trial-bridge.outcome: Six named Owen Sound shops try, for three months, a checkout that can take a crypto payment and refund it, show the fee on a twenty-dollar sale before the customer pays, and keep taking cash and cards.
checkout-trial-bridge.blocker: No one shop pays for a trial whose useful result is a public record of fees and refunds

checkout-trial-bridge.title: Trial-terms card
checkout-trial-bridge.outcome: Print the two modified sentences so a merchant and a payments person can see the trial limits in their own wording.
checkout-trial-bridge.blocker: The shared sentence leaves out why each side showed up, and the card is what keeps those reasons visible

minors-medicine.title: Rule comparison page
minors-medicine.outcome: Publish the commonality sentence as a proposal, labeled as a proposal, with no claim about current law or clinical results.
minors-medicine.blocker: A one-page proposal is useful to people who will not attend a meeting, and nobody owns the page

minors-medicine.title: Separate-questions card
minors-medicine.outcome: Print the modified-right sentence so a host can keep classroom names and school drug approval off this page.
minors-medicine.blocker: Those questions keep getting folded back in unless a maintained card holds them out

opinion-employment.title: Appeal-before-blacklist card
opinion-employment.outcome: Publish the commonality sentence and a one-page appeal checklist a workplace can fill in before treating someone as unemployable for a stated opinion.
opinion-employment.blocker: The checklist is useful to the next workplace and paid for by none of them

opinion-employment.title: Still-a-sanction note
opinion-employment.outcome: Publish the modified-left sentence so the card does not get read as a ban on every workplace response.
opinion-employment.blocker: The exception for threats and refused work disappears if only the short sentence is copied

canada-us-ties.title: Ordinary-ties one-pager
canada-us-ties.outcome: Publish the commonality sentence for one Canadian community group, labeled as a draft statement rather than as a finding about trade.
canada-us-ties.blocker: The page is a shared wording, and neither camp's organizer is paid to keep the other camp's wording intact

canada-us-ties.title: Not-an-endorsement card
canada-us-ties.outcome: Print both modified sentences beside the commonality so a reader can see the administration question was left out on purpose.
canada-us-ties.blocker: Without both wordings, one camp hears the page as praise and the other hears it as a boycott refusal they did not sign
